purpose: Describe someone doing a helpful action toward your side.
keywords: My friend showed me the way.
My older sister made dinner for me.
The teacher encouraged my younger brother.
restrictions: The benefit is viewed from the speaker or someone identified with the speaker.
mistake: The helper is the grammatical subject.

segments.role: Describe someone doing a helpful action toward your side. て-form + くれる.
